test_title: PYST 51: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A person covers 28 km while walking at a speed of 8 km/h. How much distance (in km) will he cover in same time if he walks at a speed of 6 km/h?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered = 28 km

Initial speed = 8 km/h

**Formula used:**

 Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

 The time taken to cover 28 km at 8 km/h

Time = 28 km / 8 km/h = 3.5 hours

New speed = 6 km/h

Distance covered at new speed = New speed × Time

= 6 km/h × 3.5 hours = 21 km

**He will cover 21 km at a speed of 6 km/h in the same time.**
